title: Pylon Coverage Packages Kit
eyebrow: Pylon Media · team and player packages · delivery
lead_html: What each Pylon team and player package delivers, how a crew shoots and cuts it, and the checks before anything goes to a family or a coach. Copy a card here and paste it onto the job's board.
footer_html: Built from the Pylon team and player package pages on tojcampaign.com and the app's Pylon pages guide (Nov 12, 2026). Proposed: it's a draft until an approver approves it. The pages' own words win where they differ.

columns.name: Start here
columns.lead: What a package is, and the rules nobody breaks.

cards.title: What a package is
cards.body:
A coach books coverage for a team, or a family books it for one athlete, at a Pylon event. The crew shoots it, the editor cuts it to the package, and it's delivered within 48 hours, full resolution, no watermarks, the buyer's to keep.

Each job gets its own board from this kit.

cards.title: The rules nobody breaks
cards.body:
1. Real moments only. No AI-made athletes, no synthetic edits of a real one, and no words put in anyone's mouth.
  2. No release, no camera. Consent is confirmed before anyone is filmed. Close or identifying shots of a minor (a face, a readable number) are for their family only, never public. Anything public shows a minor only wide and non-identifying (no face, name or jersey number), and only with a separate yes from a parent or guardian, recorded at the event. Texas youth: Kyron and counsel decide before the first Texas event.
  3. No promises. Nothing says or suggests an offer, a scholarship, a roster spot, exposure, followers or paid work.
  4. No marks you don't own. Pylon's marks only as Pylon's agreement allows; no NFL marks, broadcast footage or school logos on minors.
  5. Never alone with a minor. No locker rooms, training rooms or changing areas, and no one-to-one filming without a parent there.
  6. A pulled consent means pulled footage. When a family takes consent back, it comes down everywhere within 72 hours, at every event.
  7. Nothing publishes without the approver. Pylon's channels post an athlete only after an approver has read the keep-out list and cleared it.
  8. Check who they are first. Before anything is filmed or delivered for an athlete, staff call or meet the contact, check they're the parent or legal guardian (or the athlete at 18 or older) and that the email is theirs, and tap I checked: it's them.
  9. A package is the family's or the team's. What's shot for a player package goes to that family only. A team booking names no athlete.

cards.title: Who does what
cards.body:
• Staff: the request in the app (Tools → Pylon), checking the contact, payment, status: New, Contacted, Confirmed, Done.
  • Crew: the shoot, to the package's list.
  • Editor: the cut, to the deliverable spec.
  • Approver: anything that goes on Pylon's channels.

columns.name: Team packages
columns.lead: Recap, Season Pack and Combine Book: what each one owes a team.

cards.title: Team Recap ($299, per team, per event)
cards.body:
• 1 Recap Reel, Instagram-ready, sponsor-tagged when there's an active content sponsor.
  • An Action Photos Carousel: 10 slides, with the full-resolution photo pack.
  • 3 support pieces: a team highlight, single shots, individual focus.
  • 48-hour delivery, no watermarks.

cards.title: Team Season Pack ($1,499, per team, per season)
cards.body:
• The Recap Reel and the Action Carousel at every event.
  • Support content at every event, team and individual.
  • A season-end Athlete Transcript for each rostered player whose family opts in.
  • Live Event Posting bundled: each post goes through an approver and the keep-out list first, and shows minors wide and non-identifying.

cards.title: Combine Book ($2,999, per team, per season)
cards.body:
• Everything in the Season Pack.
  • Every rostered athlete graded on Optimum.
  • A printed Combine Book delivered to the head coach.
  • Coaches Directory outreach for athletes whose families opt in.
  • Contract crew coverage.

cards.title: The six-piece minimum
cards.body: Every event, every team, at least: 1 POV Reel, 1 Action Photos Carousel, 3 support pieces, and 1 team highlight when it's bundled. It's in the contract: count them before delivery.

columns.name: Player packages
columns.lead: Snapshot, Story and Feature: one athlete at one event.

cards.title: Player Snapshot ($69)
cards.body:
• 10 to 15 photos from one Pylon event, focused on the athlete, for the family only (anything public follows the rules card).
  • Full resolution, no watermarks, 48-hour delivery.

cards.title: Player Story ($99)
cards.body:
• Everything in Snapshot.
  • A short reel, 15 to 30 seconds, featuring the athlete.
  • Social-ready cuts: an Instagram Reel and a TikTok cut.

cards.title: Player Feature ($199)
cards.body:
• Everything in Story.
  • A full POV Reel to the Content 1 spec.
  • An Action Photos Carousel made for the athlete.
  • Support pieces: single shots and individual focus.

cards.title: Before you film a player
cards.body: The request shows Not checked yet until staff have checked the contact. Don't film a player package before it says checked. The crew gets the athlete by team and jersey number, never a contact.

columns.name: Shoot and cut
columns.lead: The look the pages promise, and how a crew gets it.

cards.title: The visual direction
cards.body: The pages promise one look, checked before delivery: cinematic realism, shallow depth of field, high contrast, candid emotion, bodies in motion. Shoot for it; don't fake it in the grade. That's the family's copy: anything public follows the rules card.

cards.title: Covering one athlete
cards.body:
• Know their team and jersey before the first game.
  • Every snap they're on the field: one camera on them, one wide. What's shot for the package goes to that family only.
  • Between plays: the sideline, the bench, the walk back. Candid, never staged.
  • A minor is never filmed alone, in a locker room or one to one without a parent there.

cards.title: Delivery
cards.body: 48 hours from the event for the family or the coach: full resolution, no watermarks, no expiry. Count the pieces against the package before it goes, then mark the request Done.
